name: Stacked navigation sidebars
summary: Replace the sidebar content and add a back chevron, or use the main region for details, instead of adding a second navigation sidebar.
problem: Two or three navigation columns side by side consume width, repeat structure and leave a sliver for content. Mobile has no good fallback for them.

bad.description: A primary sidebar, a secondary sidebar and a narrow content area crammed together.

good.title: Swap sidebar content
good.description: Selecting Settings replaces the sidebar content with its sections and a back control. Try it.

good.title: Sections in content
good.description: Keep one sidebar and show the secondary context as tabs and a list in the primary content.

why: One navigation column keeps the rectangle clean, preserves content width and is simpler to adapt to small screens.
exceptions: Content panes are not navigation sidebars: editors, inspectors, order books and detail panels are allowed.
A narrow icon rail for switching workspaces beside one list sidebar is an established pattern in some products; use it only when the product requires it and the rail has no second level of its own.

humanReview: Are there two navigation structures side by side?
Is the second column navigation or content?
